assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-frame playable arena floor bitmap background for an original top-down magic-and-AI roguelite.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9, precisely top-down orthographic overhead, entirely flat ground view. The middle 75 percent must be open continuous walkable floor. Rich but low-contrast surface texture, with environmental detail mostly along the narrow borders. Floor fills the entire canvas, no horizon.
Constraints: original imagery; no characters, enemies, bullets, text, symbols that resemble letters, labels, UI, watermark, perspective, tall structures or central rendered obstacles. Functional blockers will later be drawn in code. Dark subdued background so bright geometric game characters and bullets read clearly. This is one single usable floor asset, not a concept sheet.
Primary request: Mourning Grove — a dark midnight blue-green petrified forest temple floor with restrained teal fungal roots and pale fallen leaves mostly at the borders. Faint circular broken stone-and-circuit motifs etched flush into worn stone paving, subtle distressed seams and soft weathering. Moody tragic ruin, quiet and ancient. Keep roots and petrified organic remains at the outer perimeter, the center mostly bare and level. Low diffuse overhead illumination, minimal glow, no bright center focal point.
